title: Connect to an open Wi-Fi network
summary: Connects to a Wi-Fi network that does not require a password (open network). Requires knowing the network name (SSID).

steps.explain: Connects to the specified open wireless network.

placeholders.name: INTERFACE
placeholders.description: The name of your wireless interface, e.g., wlan0

placeholders.name: SSID
placeholders.description: The name of the open Wi-Fi network

steps.expect: The command completes without error, and the interface connects.

rollback.explain: Disconnects from the current wireless network.

placeholders.name: INTERFACE
placeholders.description: The name of your wireless interface, e.g., wlan0

warnings: Only works for open networks; for secured networks, use NetworkManager or iwctl.
